metadata.title: High-Performance Computing Data Protection

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for protecting the confidentiality, integrity, and appropriate use of data processed, staged, and produced by shared high-performance computing platforms.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: HPC shared filesystems, scratch storage, burst buffers, high-throughput data paths, and research data repositories.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Governs data protection, lifecycle control, and access boundaries in high-performance computing environments.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: HPC data protection assumes foundational trust in shared compute platforms and scheduler-mediated execution.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: HPC data protection depends on correct attribution and authorization of users, jobs, and scheduler actions.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Data movement, residual data risk, shared filesystem exposure, and lifecycle considerations as defined in NIST SP 800-234.

metadata.remarks: High-Performance Computing Data Protection defines trust properties required to protect data in shared, performance-oriented computing environments. This pattern makes explicit the unique risks of high-throughput data staging, shared filesystems, and residual data artifacts, recognizing that HPC platforms prioritize performance, collaboration, and scale over default data isolation.

components.title: Shared Storage Access Control
components.description: Controls access to shared HPC filesystems and data repositories.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Unauthorized data access via shared filesystem exposure.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Authorization controls limiting access to shared HPC storage resources.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Enforcement of approved access to shared HPC data.
Least privilege applied to shared storage access.

components.title: Job Data Isolation
components.description: Separates data used or produced by concurrent HPC jobs.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Data transfer or leakage through shared storage or intermediate buffers.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Logical separation of job-scoped data within shared storage systems.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Boundary protection between job-scoped data domains.
Information flow control preventing cross-job data leakage.

components.title: Data Lifecycle and Residual Risk Management
components.description: Manages data persistence, cleanup, and residual data risk following HPC job execution.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Residual data exposure from scratch storage, shared filesystems, or cached data after job completion.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Controlled retention, cleanup, and protection of HPC job data and artifacts.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Controlled removal and sanitization of temporary and job-scoped storage.
Integrity protection for HPC data throughout its lifecycle.
